research.notes: From the MIDI file’s synth brass track, bars 30–33. The file doubles it at the octave; this is the upper octave. Its timing is played in, so starts and lengths are rounded to the triplet sixteenth, which holds both the eighths and the triplets. The pickup at the end of bar 33 is the one that starts the next phrase, so the loop leads back into itself. The Songsterr transcription (Leonard, 2010) is a solo-guitar arrangement in G, so nothing confirms it. _In the style of_: the notes come from fan transcriptions, which the method counts as starting points, not sources.
